title: Enfamil Gentlease Infant Formula, Powder, Made with Tap Water

content.title: About
content.content: Enfamil Gentlease is a powdered infant formula designed to ease colic and gas in babies. The formula contains partially hydrolyzed proteins, easily digestible carbohydrates, and prebiotics, making it gentler on a child's digestive system. It is prepared with clean tap water according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Gentlease uses partially hydrolyzed proteins to reduce the risk of allergic reactions in sensitive infants.
The formula is fortified with DHA and ARA, fatty acids important for brain and eye development.
It includes prebiotic fibers (FOS) that support a healthy gut microbiome.
Enfamil Gentlease is suitable for infants from birth up to 12 months who need a milder formula.
The recommended preparation temperature is 37 °C to preserve nutritional quality.

items.title: Gentle digestion
items.content: Partially hydrolyzed proteins are easier to break down, reducing colic and gas.

items.title: Brain development
items.content: DHA and ARA support the growth of the central nervous system and visual function.

items.title: Healthy gut flora
items.content: Prebiotics promote the growth of beneficial bacteria, enhancing immunity.

items.title: Balanced vitamins and minerals
items.content: The formula provides iron, calcium, vitamin D, and other micronutrients essential for growth.

items.title: Support for growth and weight gain
items.content: An optimal ratio of protein, fat, and carbohydrates supplies energy and promotes healthy weight gain.

items.title: Cow‑milk protein allergy
items.content: Despite partial hydrolysis, the product contains cow’s milk; consult a pediatrician if an allergy is suspected.

items.title: Improper preparation
items.content: Water that is too hot can degrade nutrients, while water that is too cold may lead to poor dissolution.

items.title: Concentration control
items.content: An overly concentrated mixture can strain an infant’s kidneys; follow the dosing instructions precisely.

items.title: Shelf‑life after opening
items.content: Use the opened container within 30 days and keep it sealed in a dry place.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Prepare the formula by mixing the measured amount of powder with 37 °C clean tap water, stirring until smooth. If desired, up to 10 % of the total volume may be replaced with previously expressed breast milk, but not more.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the bag tightly sealed and use within one month. Do not refrigerate, as moisture can cause clumping.
